lines:
classDiagram
direction LR
class ChatRunStreamV1 {
  +ChatId chatId PK
  +RunId runId EQUALS_CHAT
  +SessionId sessionId EQUALS_CHAT
  +BranchId branchId
  +HistoryBackend backend LOCAL_SQLITE
  +uint64 headSequence
  +uint64 aggregateVersion
}
class SemanticEventV1 {
  +EventId eventId UNIQUE
  +ChatId chatId FK
  +BranchId branchId FK
  +uint64 sequence
  +uint64 aggregateVersion
  +AttemptId attemptId OPTIONAL
  +SpanId spanId OPTIONAL
  +EventId causationEventId OPTIONAL
  +string kind
  +uint16 schemaVersion
  +json payload
}
class SemanticSpanStartData {
  +SpanId spanId UNIQUE
  +SpanId parentSpanId OPTIONAL
  +string spanKind
  +string semanticRole
  +json normalizedRedactedInput
  +ArtifactId inputArtifact OPTIONAL
}
class SemanticSpanTerminalData {
  +SpanId spanId
  +string status
  +json normalizedRedactedOutput
  +ArtifactId outputArtifact OPTIONAL
  +ErrorRef errorRef OPTIONAL
}
class AttemptV1 {
  +AttemptId attemptId UNIQUE
  +OperationId operationId
  +uint32 ordinal
  +string outcomeClass
}
class LocalLedgerCheckpointV1 {
  +ChatId chatId FK
  +BranchId branchId FK
  +uint64 throughSequence
  +string reducerVersion
  +Hash stateHash
  +ArtifactId frozenSnapshotRef
}
class DedupRecordV1 {
  +string keyType
  +IdempotencyKey key
  +Hash requestHash
  +EventId outcomeEventId
  +uint64 commitSequence
}
class OutboxRecordV1 {
  +OutboxId outboxId UNIQUE
  +ChatId chatId
  +uint64 commitSequence
  +Hash payloadHash
  +string deliveryState
}
class ArtifactMetadataV1 {
  +ArtifactId artifactId UNIQUE
  +Hash contentHash
  +uint64 byteSize
  +EventId originEventId
  +string availability
}
class VersionedConfigDocument {
  +DocumentId documentId UNIQUE
  +string logicalKind
  +uint64 documentVersion
  +uint32 schemaVersion
  +Hash contentHash
  +CredentialRef opaqueRefOnly
}
class WorkflowDocument {
  +WorkflowId workflowId UNIQUE
  +uint64 documentVersion
  +uint32 schemaVersion
  +Hash contentHash
  +json completeGraph
}
class ExtensionRecordV1 {
  +ExtensionId extensionId
  +string version
  +Hash contentHash
  +uint64 recordVersion
}
class ErrorGroupV1 {
  +Fingerprint fingerprint PK
  +uint64 ledgerVersion
  +string status
}
class RepairCandidateV1 {
  +CandidateId candidateId UNIQUE
  +uint64 candidateVersion
  +Hash candidateHash
  +ArtifactId evidenceRef
  +RollbackPointId rollbackPoint
}
ChatRunStreamV1 "1" *-- "0..*" SemanticEventV1 : UNIQUE chat branch sequence
SemanticEventV1 --> SemanticSpanStartData : SpanStarted payload
SemanticEventV1 --> SemanticSpanTerminalData : terminal payload
SemanticSpanStartData "0..1" --> "0..*" SemanticSpanStartData : immutable parent
ChatRunStreamV1 "1" *-- "0..*" AttemptV1 : stable retry identities
ChatRunStreamV1 "1" *-- "0..*" LocalLedgerCheckpointV1 : sequence and state hash
SemanticEventV1 "0..*" --> "0..1" AttemptV1 : attemptId
SemanticEventV1 "0..*" --> "0..*" ArtifactMetadataV1 : immutable references
DedupRecordV1 "0..*" --> "1" SemanticEventV1 : original durable outcome
OutboxRecordV1 "0..*" --> "1" SemanticEventV1 : committed delivery
VersionedConfigDocument --> ExtensionRecordV1 : logical plugin id only
WorkflowDocument --> VersionedConfigDocument : logical capability refs
ErrorGroupV1 "1" *-- "0..*" RepairCandidateV1 : append only lifecycle
RepairCandidateV1 --> ArtifactMetadataV1 : hashed diff and verification evidence

data.title: Local Canonical Records, Stable IDs, and Hierarchical Spans
